fields.notificationEmailHint: Leave empty to use the store email.

errors.whatsappInvalid: Enter the number with its country code, like +971 50 000 0000.
errors.timeSame: Opening and closing times can't be the same.
errors.socialInvalid: Enter a link to your profile on this site (https://…), or an @handle.
errors.taxRateInvalid: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, with up to 2 decimals.
errors.taxRateRequired: Enter the tax rate, or turn tax off.
errors.daysInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 0 to 365.
errors.daysOrder: Must be the same as or more than the first number.
errors.quantityInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10,000.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that. Sign in again as an administrator.
errors.notFound: The store settings record is missing. Reload the page.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed the settings since you opened them. Reload the page to see the latest version, then try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Nothing was changed — try again when you're online.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed — please try again.
errors.logoUploadFailed: Settings saved, but the logo couldn't be updated. Try again.
errors.logoCleanupFailed: Settings saved, but the old logo file couldn't be deleted from storage.

settings.shippingMoved: Delivery charges, free-delivery thresholds and delivery estimates are now set for each country on the Shipping page.

currencies.subtitle: Currencies the store sells in, and the countries it ships to. Each product needs a price in a currency to be sold in it; prices are never converted.
currencies.notReadyBody: Apply database migration 031 (multi-currency) to manage currencies and prices.
currencies.disabled: {code} disabled. Its prices are kept but no longer shown in the store.
currencies.defaultLocked: The default currency is always enabled.
currencies.note: Visitors see prices in their delivery country's currency (else their location's, else the default) and can switch in the store header. Checkout is limited to the countries listed.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to change currencies.
errors.notFound: This currency no longer exists or isn't enabled.
errors.defaultRequired: The default currency can't be disabled. Make another currency the default first.
errors.failed: Couldn't save the change. Please try again.

csv.title: Prices CSV
csv.description: Export every product's prices, edit them in a spreadsheet, and import them back. Columns: product_sku, variant_sku, currency, price, sale_price.
csv.hint: Amounts use the currency's decimals (e.g. 1.500 for BHD). An empty price removes that price; leave variant_sku empty for the product's own price. Nothing is saved if any line has a problem.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to change prices.
errors.empty: Choose a CSV file with at least one price.
errors.fileTooLarge: The file is too large (2 MB at most).
errors.invalid: Nothing was imported. Fix these lines and try again:
errors.baseRequired: Nothing was imported: a product's price in its own currency can't be removed (edit it instead).
errors.failed: Couldn't import the prices. Please try again.

rowErrors.skuUnknown: no product or variant with this SKU
rowErrors.duplicate: this product, variant and currency appear more than once
rowErrors.priceRequired: a sale price needs a price
rowErrors.priceTooManyDecimals: too many decimals for this currency
rowErrors.salePriceNotLower: the sale price must be lower than the price

dialog.addDescription: Customers can pick it in the store's currency switcher once it's enabled. Products are sold in it only once they have a price in it.
dialog.editDescription: The code and decimals can't change: prices in this currency are stored in its smallest unit.
dialog.codeHint: ISO 4217 currency. The symbol and decimals are filled in for you.
dialog.symbolHint: Shown in the store's currency switcher (e.g. BD, KD, ₹).
dialog.decimalsHint: Digits after the decimal point: 3 for BHD, KWD and OMR, 2 for most others. Can't be changed later.
dialog.enableNowHint: Show it in the store's currency switcher straight away. You can enable it later instead.
dialog.created: {code} added. Add prices in it from the product form or the prices CSV.

errors.codeInvalid: Choose a currency from the list.
errors.codeTaken: This currency has already been added.

currencies.switcherOnly: Not tied to a shipping country: customers pick it in the currency switcher.

shipping.subtitle: Delivery charges and estimates for each country the store delivers to. Each country is charged in its own currency.
shipping.notReadyBody: Apply database migration 037 (shipping management) to configure delivery by country.
shipping.emptyBody: Add a country to start delivering to it.

methodHints.STANDARD: Everyday delivery at the lower rate.
methodHints.EXPRESS: Faster delivery at a higher rate.

rateTypeHints.FLAT: One charge per order, whatever is in it.
rateTypeHints.WEIGHT_BASED: Priced by parcel weight (product and variant weights).
rateTypeHints.ORDER_BASED: Priced by bands of the order subtotal.

shipping.blocked: No delivery method is enabled: checkout is blocked.
shipping.disableBody: Customers with an address there can't check out until you enable it again. Its rates are kept.
shipping.note: Changes apply to new checkouts. Placed orders keep the delivery method and charge they were placed with.

add.title: Add a delivery country
add.description: Choose one of the countries the store sells in. It starts disabled with draft Standard and Express methods, so you can set its rates before enabling it.
add.none: Every country the store sells in already has a shipping configuration. Add a currency and its countries first to deliver elsewhere.
add.added: {country} added. Set its rates, then enable it.

detail.statusHint: When off, checkout to this country is blocked. Needs at least one enabled method.
detail.amountHint: Charged once per order. 0 = always free.
detail.thresholdHint: Orders with at least this subtotal ship free. Leave empty to always charge.
detail.daysHint: Shown to customers as the delivery estimate.
detail.previewUnavailable: Customers in {country} can't check out: delivery is disabled.
detail.deleteBody: Its configuration is removed and checkout to it is blocked. Placed orders keep their own copy of what was charged.
detail.deleteInUse: Orders used this configuration, so it can only be disabled.
detail.unweighed: {count} active products have no weight of their own: their items count as 0 kg unless the chosen variant has a weight. Add weights on the product pages.
detail.weightBandsHint: Parcel weight = quantity × each item's weight.
detail.orderBandsHint: By the order subtotal, before delivery.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to change shipping.
errors.notFound: This country's shipping configuration no longer exists.
errors.exists: This country already has a shipping configuration.
errors.countryNotSold: The store doesn't sell in this country. Add it on the Currencies page first.
errors.noActiveMethod: Enable at least one delivery method before enabling this country.
errors.stale: This configuration was changed meanwhile (another tab or admin). Reload to see the latest version, then save again.
errors.inUse: Orders used this configuration, so it can't be deleted. Disable it instead.
errors.invalid: Some values aren't valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.failed: Couldn't save the change. Please try again.

fieldErrors.priceRequired: Enter an amount (0 for free delivery).
fieldErrors.priceTooManyDecimals: Too many decimals for this currency.
fieldErrors.daysOrder: Must be at least the first day.
fieldErrors.rateTypeUnsupported: This rate type isn't available yet.
fieldErrors.upToNotHigher: Must be higher than where the band starts.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Online card and Apple Pay payments through Stripe.
payments.missingBody: Apply database migration 044 (supabase/migrations) to enable online payments.

connection.title: Stripe connection
connection.keysNote: Keys are read from the server's environment and never shown here.
connection.webhookHint: Add this URL in Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks with the events listed in the README.
connection.chargesDisabled: Not enabled yet — finish activating the account in Stripe.
connection.liveMismatch: The stored account was checked with a different key mode. Check it again.

settings.title: Checkout
settings.enableHint: Customers pay by card or Apple Pay when they place an order. When off, orders are placed without online payment, as before.
settings.currenciesHint: Only currencies your Stripe account supports are offered. Checkout in any other currency is blocked while online payments are on.
settings.notSupported: Not supported by this Stripe account
settings.threeDecimalNote: KWD, BHD and OMR amounts are charged to the fils / baisa. Some card networks only accept amounts ending in 0, so price these currencies in steps of 0.010.
settings.verifyFirst: Check the Stripe account first to see which currencies it supports.
settings.windowHint: How long an unpaid order keeps its items reserved (15–1440). Then it's cancelled and they go back into stock.

errors.currencyUnsupported: Stripe doesn't support {codes} for this account.
errors.currencyDecimals: {codes}: the store's decimals don't match Stripe's. Fix them in Currencies first.
errors.windowInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes between 15 and 1440.
errors.notVerified: Check the Stripe account before switching payments on.
errors.chargesDisabled: This Stripe account can't take payments yet.
errors.webhookMissing: Set STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the server first: without webhooks, payments are never confirmed.

applePay.title: Apple Pay
applePay.body: Apple Pay appears in checkout on Safari and Apple devices once the storefront's domain is registered and active here. Stripe handles Apple's merchant verification; no file needs to be hosted. Register every domain customers use (e.g. both example.com and www.example.com).
applePay.requirements: Also needed: HTTPS, Apple Pay switched on in Stripe Dashboard → Settings → Payment methods, and a customer device with a card in Apple Wallet.
applePay.testModeNote: Domains registered in live mode are also available in test mode.
